title: SparkleMe First-Pass CAMS Result
description: Strict structured output returned by the inference engine for a single client (5 drape images). flow_result must be one of the 10 palettes AND a valid flow of home_season. leaning, when non-null, must be a different valid flow of the same home_season.

home_season.description: The chosen Home Season from Phase B pairwise comparisons.

flow_result.description: Final palette. Must be a valid flow of home_season.

leaning.description: Neighbouring palette the result leans toward for a genuine boundary case (the 'True X moving slightly toward Y' runner-up), else null. When non-null must be a valid flow of home_season and differ from flow_result.

steps.description: Ordered record of every comparison performed across Phases A-D.

step.description: Comparison label, e.g. 'Phase B: Winter vs Summer' or 'Phase C: True Winter vs Deep'.

winner.description: Palette or Home Season that won this step; use 'tie' if genuinely tied and carried forward.

criteria_cited.description: Which of the 7 CAMS checks drove the step: 1 Facial Details, 2 Skin Colour, 3 Skin Consistency, 4 Jawline, 5 Eyes, 6 Focus, 7 Balance/Harmony.

reasoning.description: Image-grounded justification. Must classify any advantage as physiological vs palette-created, not generic language.

final_reasoning.description: Whole-face summary: why the winner won, why the runner-up lost, and the outcome of the anti-bias gates.
